summary: Added the control the investigation's own discriminator called for, since the asserted account still lacked it: the same joint configuration with an empty ConfChangeV2 that carries the documented Auto transition. The harness now runs both forms in one invocation, and a local run shows the Auto form has LeaveJoint true and EnterJoint ok false, and applying it leaves the joint configuration (joint_after false, voters after [1 2 3 4]) with no panic - against the explicit form's panic with config is already joint and still_joint true. That distinguishes the defect from a general problem with empty change sets: it is specific to the transition field, which propose-time validation ignores and the apply path keys on. Submitted as a successor experiment for the same investigation with two control comparisons (panicked false and joint_after false) and its scope, prefix and prerequisite, so the controller can produce the receipt. The already-recorded asserted claim is unchanged; I also dropped an unverifiable knowledge reference from the experiment record so the submission validates cleanly.
